blockingFindings.description: V73 crouch and sit renders show both thighs passing through the front overskirt/apron, leaving large uncovered areas while fabric hangs below and behind the knees.
Front, neutral, and three-quarter views retain a deeply pinched center seam, irregular overlapping panels, and abrupt hem steps; the apron does not read as a coherent finished garment.
Side and rear views show coarse accordion folds, sharp intersecting points, and inner panels hanging below the rear hem; the skirt drape remains visibly unresolved.
The rear adjustment tab projects away from the garment as a rigid flap instead of sitting against the back.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
